title: Native proper coefficient-operation data
statement: For a prime $\ell$, schemes $Z,Y$ with $\ell$ invertible and a morphism $p:Z\to Y$, use the native continuous coefficient rings and ordinary module presentations of [lem-sf-adic-qbar-constructible-realization] on the small sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define the coefficient-operation datum to consist of the inverse-image coefficient map, along the pro-etale inverse image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] of coefficient sheaves of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], whose adjunct is precomposition of functions, the actual balanced module pullback and its ordinary left-derived functor [def-per-continuous-rational-realization-data] and the ordinary module and right-derived pushforward of [lem-a1-rational-direct-image-realization], their adjunctions normalized by insertion of one and by cochain transpose, and the actual left-derived pullback computation counit. At each finite coefficient field of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] define the balanced integral scalar comparison between the ordinary integral module pullback [def-sf-ordinary-integral-pullback-construction] and its left-derived functor [def-sf-ordinary-integral-derived-pullback], extended to the native ring, and the native pullback, by its unit-generator equation and derived computation-counit square; its ordinary/completed pullback comparison is the actual quotient-tower map of [lem-tw-ordinary-completed-integral-pullback]. Define agreement of a common-stage comparison with these data by the explicit composite of the raw-localization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] object transports for [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], integral realization, inverse completion unit and balanced scalar extension. These are data types and normalization predicates; their existence is a separate assertion.
